---
title: "`gammaSST` validation"
---

The `gammaSST` model [@Menter2015] is from Turbulence Community (TC) repository and is not part of standard OpenFOAM distribution. Nevertheless, the `myTurbulenceModels` library can include it. See [Introduction](/index.qmd) for more details.

# Coupland T3A-T3C5 cases

Results for the Coupland T3A-T3C5 showed bellow are obtained with medium mesh resolution.

See [description](/Validation/Coupland/T3A/index.qmd).
